_units: USD per million tokens, first-party Claude API list prices
_no_pricing_api: There is no first-party JSON pricing endpoint. The machine-readable source is the docs Markdown named in _source; GET /v1/models returns ids, context windows and capabilities but no prices. The only programmatic source of ACTUAL billed USD is the Admin API cost report (GET /v1/organizations/cost_report), which needs an Admin API key, is daily granularity only, groups by workspace or description, and returns decimal strings in cents. It therefore cannot attribute spend to a single benchmark run unless that run gets a workspace of its own.
_rates_note: cache_write_5m is 1.25x base input and cache_write_1h is 2x, on every model. cache_read is 0.1x base input everywhere except Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, which are 0.025x. A dated model id (claude-opus-5-20260301) is priced as its alias (claude-opus-5); a model absent under either name is an extraction error, never a guess.
_modes_note: fast_input/fast_output replace the base pair under fast mode and keep the model's own cache multipliers, so a fast cache read is 0.1x the fast input rate. geo_multipliers scales every token category and is published for Claude 4.6 and later only. batch_multiplier is the Batch API discount and applies to input and output, the two categories the source states it for.
